Audience: first-time Hawaii class three applicants, including minors on the graduated path, learning sign colors and shapes, regulatory signs such as stop, yield, speed limit, lane use, do not pass, no passing zone, pass with care, alignment and exclusion signs, warning signs, guide and information signs, and construction and maintenance devices including channelizing devices, arrow panels and flagpersons in plain English.

Prerequisites: the device categories introduced with pavement markings and the no-passing rules of the traffic laws section, which these signs put on posts.

Scope note: sign colors and shapes, the regulatory signs for stop, yield, speed limits, reduced speed, lane use, do not pass, no passing zone, pass with care, alignment and exclusion, warning signs and their examples, guide and information signs, and construction and maintenance signs, channelizing devices, barricade stripes, arrow panels and flagpersons. Crash procedures follow in the next section.

Recall emphasis: sign meanings are practiced as recall items, and sign identification by color and shape feeds the dedicated recognition surface declared in part C.
